\section*{Proof of \texttt{bernstein-variance}}
\textbf{Claim.}
\begin{align*}
  \begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall \operatorname{n\_}. \forall \operatorname{x\_}. \forall \operatorname{h\_}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{n\_} \in \mathbb{N}) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{x\_} \in \mathbb{R}) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall \operatorname{k\_} \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{h\_}(\operatorname{k\_}) = (((\operatorname{k\_} - (\operatorname{n\_} \cdot \operatorname{x\_})) \cdot (\operatorname{k\_} - (\operatorname{n\_} \cdot \operatorname{x\_}))) \cdot \operatorname{bernstein\text{-}basis}(\operatorname{n\_}, \operatorname{x\_})(\operatorname{k\_}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}(\operatorname{h\_}, (\operatorname{n\_} + 1)) \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad =\; ((\operatorname{n\_} \cdot \operatorname{x\_}) \cdot (1 - \operatorname{x\_})) \end{array}
\end{align*}
\bigskip

\subsection*{Tactics used}
\begin{itemize}
\item \texttt{sp} -- start the proof: install the claim as the initial goal
\item \texttt{di} -- direct inference: break the goal at its top connective -- move an implication's hypothesis into the assumptions, split a conjunction, or introduce a universally quantified variable
\item \texttt{cut} -- cut: introduce an intermediate lemma, discharged as a side goal
\item \texttt{ass} -- assert: close the goal directly from the assumptions
\item \texttt{inst+} -- instantiate and detach: specialise a universal assumption at a term, then discharge its in-context guards
\item \texttt{subst} -- substitute: rewrite the goal using an equality assumption
\end{itemize}

\subsection*{Notation}
\begin{itemize}
\item $\Rightarrow$ -- implies
\item $\in$ -- set membership
\item $\mathbb{N}$ -- the natural numbers
\item $\mathbb{R}$ -- the real numbers
\item $\mathbb{Z}$ -- the integers
\end{itemize}

\subsection*{Derivation}
Each step shows the tactic applied; the goal nodes it opens and which one is now in focus (the bracketed \texttt{[k]} of the workspace display); the focus node's assumptions (\textbf{A1}, \textbf{A2}, \dots{}, the numbering the tactic args refer to); and the goal $G$ it leaves, written $\vdash G$.  Each sequent is an \texttt{align*} environment: break a long formula by hand with \texttt{\textbackslash\textbackslash\ \&} and indent at the alignment column.

  \mathbf{A84.}\quad & \begin{array}{@{}l@{}} (\operatorname{n\_} \in \mathbb{N}) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad (\operatorname{n\_} \in \mathbb{Z}) \end{array} \\
  \mathbf{A85.}\quad & \begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad (n \in \mathbb{Z}) \end{array} \\
  \mathbf{A86.}\quad & (1 \in \mathbb{R}) \\
  \mathbf{A87.}\quad & (\operatorname{n\_} \in \mathbb{R}) \\
  \mathbf{A88.}\quad & \begin{array}{@{}l@{}} (\operatorname{n\_} \in \mathbb{N}) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad (\operatorname{n\_} \in \mathbb{R}) \end{array} \\
  \mathbf{A89.}\quad & \begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad (k \in \mathbb{R}) \end{array} \\
  \mathbf{A90.}\quad & \begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall \operatorname{k\_} \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{h\_}(\operatorname{k\_}) \\ \quad =\; (((\operatorname{k\_} - (\operatorname{n\_} \cdot \operatorname{x\_})) \cdot (\operatorname{k\_} - (\operatorname{n\_} \cdot \operatorname{x\_}))) \cdot \operatorname{bernstein\text{-}basis}(\operatorname{n\_}, \operatorname{x\_})(\operatorname{k\_})) \end{array} \\
  \mathbf{A91.}\quad & (\operatorname{x\_} \in \mathbb{R}) \\
  \mathbf{A92.}\quad & (\operatorname{n\_} \in \mathbb{N}) \\
  \vdash\quad & \begin{array}{@{}l@{}} (((\operatorname{n\_} \cdot (\operatorname{n\_} - 1)) \cdot (\operatorname{x\_} \cdot \operatorname{x\_})) + ((((1 - (\operatorname{n\_} \cdot \operatorname{x\_})) - (\operatorname{n\_} \cdot \operatorname{x\_})) \cdot (\operatorname{n\_} \cdot \operatorname{x\_})) + (((\operatorname{n\_} \cdot \operatorname{x\_}) \cdot (\operatorname{n\_} \cdot \operatorname{x\_})) \cdot 1))) \\ =\; ((\operatorname{n\_} \cdot \operatorname{x\_}) \cdot (1 - \operatorname{x\_})) \end{array}
\end{align*}
\medskip\noindent\textbf{154.}\quad \fit{\texttt{(crs)}}\hfill{\small adds no nodes}\\[2pt]
